pairs.l: 1 — We left the oven on. It's on your way from work, so please help out!
2 — There's a new notice on the board. Don't forget to check it out tomorrow.
3 — I tried to reach you by phone but couldn't get through. I'd like to hear from you.
4 — Do your homework before going to the book club or you'll forget.
5 — Dreaming big like studying in Australia is not far-fetched. I believe in you.

r1.exp: Poruka 1 (zaboravili ostavili pećnicu upaljenbu — ugasi je) = D (Turn it off). Poruka 2 (pročitaj obavijest na ploči) = C (Read it). Poruka 3 (nisam te mogao dobiti — javi mi se) = A (Contact me). Poruka 4 (napravi domaću zadaću odmah, ne odgađaj) = B (Don't put it off). Poruka 5 (studiranje u Australiji — vjerujem u tebe, probaj) = F (Go for it).

r6.exp: 'You know me, I'm so IMPATIENT!' = ne može čekati = C (Because she couldn't wait).

r7.exp: Bella + 12 = 13 putnika. 4 su izašla (ostalo 9). Ušao je par starijih (2) → 9 + 2 = 11 na kraju (B).

r8.exp: 'Moved away from painting mythological scenes... non-traditional materials' → svidjelo joj se što nije bilo tradicionalno = A.

r9.exp: 'He PUT ON QUITE A SHOW' → nastup pjevača je bio impresivan (C). Glas nije bio jak, ali sve ostalo je bilo odlično.

r10.exp: 'Reasonable' = razumna cijena, ni jeftina (bargain) ni skupa = C (medium-priced). Nadali su se popustu ali nisu dobili, ipak im nije smetalo.

r11.exp: 'The majority begin reading on their own... as a result of their PARENTS reading to them' → roditelji = C.

r12.exp: 'Interesting, realistic and INSPIRING' → inspiring = motivirajuće = B (Stories that are motivating).

r13.exp: 'Struggle with concepts that are SYMBOLIC OR ABSTRACT' → apstraktnost je najtežja = A.

r14.exp: 'PUZZLED by unfamiliar words' = zbunjeni nepoznatim riječima = B (They feel confused).

r15.exp: 'When children are encouraged to read WHAT THEY WANT, they are motivated' → pustiti ih da biraju = C.

r16.exp: 'He was working as inspector (16)____. Lying in his hospital bed...' → C: when he was struck down by pneumonia. Inspektor je obolio od upale pluća i završio u bolnici.

r17.exp: 'Existential crisis took hold of him (17)____. He could barely work.' → F: that would not go away even after the illness had passed. Kriza ga nije napuštala ni nakon bolesti.

r18.exp: 'Returned to the family farm, (18)____.' → E: and his father set him to work in the mandarin orchard. Vratio se na obiteljsku farmu i otac ga je postavio na rad u voćnjak.

r19.exp: 'Cultivating his father's fruit trees, (19)____.' → B: he started to question every aspect of conventional agricultural practice. Dok je obrađivao, počeo je preispitivati konvencionalnu poljoprivredu.

r20.exp: 'Nature was a complete and unified whole, (20)____.' → D: and could therefore function without human intervention. Priroda je cjelina i može funkcionirati bez ljudskog miješanja.

r21.exp: 'Don't WASTE time on paperwork' — fiksna kolokacija: waste time (gubiti/trošiti vrijeme).

r22.exp: 'Two of WHICH have already worked for us' — relativna zamjenica 'which' za ne-žive imenice/broj.

r23.exp: 'You will RECOGNISE them immediately' = odmah ćeš ih prepoznati (jer su već radili za firmu).

r24.exp: 'Fill IN the form' — fiksni frazalni glagol: fill in (a form) = ispuniti obrazac.

r25.exp: 'Yesterday morning I PLACED their applications' — past simple za radnju u točno određenom trenutku u prošlosti ('yesterday morning').

r26.exp: 'A SHARP pain' — fiksna kolokacija: sharp pain = oštra/probadajuća bol.

r27.exp: 'A SORE throat' — fiksna kolokacija: sore throat = upaljeno grlo.

r28.exp: 'He MADE an appointment' — fiksna kolokacija: make an appointment (zakazati termin).

r29.exp: 'TOOK his temperature' — fiksna kolokacija: take someone's temperature (izmjeriti temperaturu).

r30.exp: 'Have anything to DO with my cold' — fiksni izraz: have to do with = imati veze s.

sol.rubric: Odgovori na sva 3 pitanja: (1) na kojoj si zadnjoj zabavi bio/la i kakva je bila, (2) koje je najbolje mjesto za zabavu i zašto, (3) što čini sjajnu zabavu. Dužina 80–100 riječi. Neformalan registar.

w1.exp: Pisani zadatak — nema jednog točnog odgovora. Ocjenjuju se sadržaj (odgovori na sva pitanja), jezik i dužina (80–100 riječi).
